A converted docling document

Source: R/document.R
doclr_document.Rd

The object returned by doclr_convert() and friends. It holds whichever representations the server produced — controlled by the to_formats argument of doclr_options() — plus the conversion status and any errors the server reported. Pull content out with as_markdown(), as_text(), as_html(), as_json() or as_doctags().
